diagnosis_summary: The compiler closes cleanly through PASS-08 (fixed-point existence, non-uniqueness proven) and PASS-09 partially (spectral machinery exists but does not yet apply to the specific derived-seed family at tested N). Every pass from PASS-10 onward is genuinely BLOCKED or NOT ATTEMPTED, each for an EXPLICIT, DIAGNOSED reason (missing lambda_gap, insufficient N for continuum approximation, or a source-documented empirically-rejected physical route), not from lack of effort or an arbitrary stopping point.
